---
title: "Labels"
---

Add a short label below a heading, in a paragraph, or in a table to show a document’s status, topic, or scope.

## Add a label

Add `.askr-label` for the label style and a second class to select a color. This example uses deep navy for “Technical preview”.

[Technical preview]{.askr-label .askr-label-navy}

```markdown
[Technical preview]{.askr-label .askr-label-navy}
```

Choose any text and color independently. With just `.askr-label`, the label uses slate. Quarto site search indexes the visible label text. To filter a page listing by category, use Quarto’s `categories` metadata.

## Color palette

Each group lists the color names in display order. Prefix the name with `.askr-label-` to use it.

### Neutrals

[Slate]{.askr-label .askr-label-slate} [Stone]{.askr-label .askr-label-stone} [Sand]{.askr-label .askr-label-sand}

`slate` · `stone` · `sand`
